topic.title: News Volatility Can Change the Trading Environment

research.summary: High-impact economic releases can coincide with rapid price movement, wider spreads, and sudden changes in liquidity conditions. That does not tell you which direction price will move. It tells you the environment may be different from a quiet session. Knowing the calendar and adjusting your risk process is part of responsible market preparation.
